project.name: Minetest Game
notes: Game package requiring the separately installed Luanti engine; not a standalone application. Desktop platform availability follows the engine; this exact game/engine combination has not been runtime-tested.
game.conf declares minimum engine version 5.8. README states rolling releases and compatibility with the latest stable engine; confirm the installed versions.
Peaceful basic sandbox with no NPCs, monsters or animals; upstream is in maintenance-only mode. Not a feature-equivalent Minecraft replacement.
Top-level source/media declarations only. Per-mod README and asset notices may contain additional license terms and attribution requirements; full per-file audit remains pending.
